naslov: Mavericks' Cooper Flagg out for home opener with mild left shoulder sprain
tekst:
DALLAS -- Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI on Saturday morning that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced.
Flagg has been ruled out of Saturday night's home opener against the San Antonio Spurs. He will be reevaluated next week.
The reigning Rookie of the Year, Flagg suffered the injury when he took a flagrant foul by Indiana Pacers forward Aaron Nesmith on a breakaway late in the second quarter of the Mavericks' road win Friday night. Flagg exited moments later and did not return to the game.
Flagg, 19, was off to a fast start in his second season. He scored 32 points in Wednesday's loss to the Houston Rockets, the highest-scoring performance ever by a teenager in a season opener. He had 14 points, six assists, five rebounds, three steals and a block in 17 minutes before exiting against the Pacers.
